text.en:
2. The development, improvement, conservation and exploitation of
agriculture, fisheries, forests, and minerals and other natural resources
in the Federation, and the provision, acquisition, improvement and
replacement of capital assets required in respect thereof or in connection
therewith.

3. The acquisition of land and of any right or interest in or over land
and in respect of the use of any invention.

4. The carrying on of any survey, research, or investigution preparatory
to the undertaking of any such purpose as is referred to in paragraphs |
and 2 of this Schedule or to the formation of any plan or scheme for the
development, improvement, conservation or exploitation of the resources
of the Federation or of any part thereof.

6. Grants and loans to any Government in the Federation and grants
and loans to or investment in public and statutory authorities and any
other body or any person for any one or more of the purposes referred
to in paragraphs 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 of this Schedule.

7. The payment of any sum subscribed by the Government pursuant to
section 6 of the Central Bank of Malaysia Ordinance, 1958, in respect
of the authorised capital of the Central Bank of Malaysia.

8. The payment of any sum subscribed by the Government as equity
investment in the authorised capital of Bank Bumiputra licensed under
the Banking Ordinance, 1958.

9, The payment of any sum subscribed by the Government as investment
in the authorised capital of the Malayawata Steel Limited registered
under the Companies Act, 1965.

DEVELOPMENT FUNDS                        561

10. The payment of any sum subscribed by the Government for any
investment authorised by a resolution of the House of Representatives
under paragraph (d) of sub-section (3) of section 8 of the Financial
Procedure Ordinance, 1957.
